title: EATF Action Evidence Package toolkit
description: Open toolkit for creating, inspecting, and offline-verifying Action Evidence Packages (.aep): a hybrid RSA-4096 plus ML-DSA-65 signer, two verifiers (TypeScript and Python), both built by Tyche Institute, sign/verify/inspect CLIs, RFC 9881 public-key encoding, JSON schemas, positive and negative conformance vectors, and a deterministic offline downgrade lab.
notes: Version 0.6.1 makes the deterministic six-package ML-DSA lab download runnable from its extracted directory after one-time verifier setup. The ZIP now includes its cross-platform Python runner and shell launcher, documents EATF_REPO_ROOT/PATH setup, verifies every packaged SHA-256 value, and is exercised from a fresh extraction in CI. Across six packages and two policies, the two verifiers (TypeScript and Python, both built by Tyche Institute) return the same verdict and first-failure code for every package-policy pair: 24 observations, zero mismatches. Version DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21763768. Previous version v0.6.0 is doi:10.5281/zenodo.21763056 under concept doi:10.5281/zenodo.21763055; releases through v0.5.0 remain under earlier concept doi:10.5281/zenodo.21511608.
